content:
Message from ORA

From the ORA eTraining module "Supporting Participants: Payments, Benefits, and Indirect Costs" (lesson 9 of 9).
Training Development is on the Rise at MSU!
Thank you so much for reviewing our training module exploring research activities that impact participant support costs on sponsored projects! Modules are constantly in development to provide guidance on other grant administration activities at MSU. Visit our webpage here for more training and resource material. If you have questions, or any suggestions for module development, please feel encouraged to contact the ORA Training and Communications Coordinator, Ryan Mobley. As always, please feel free to send any questions related to the administration of your sponsored award to ask.ora@morgan.edu. See you next time!
